issues.legal_issue: A debt renewed after commencement of the relief legislation remains subject to the scaling rule applicable to the period when the original indebtedness arose.
material_facts: The debtors were agriculturists, and their dealings with the creditors began before the relief legislation commenced but after its cutoff for older debts.
After the legislation commenced, the debtors executed a promissory note for the amount due from those dealings.
The creditors sued for the amount they claimed remained due under the note.
issues.conclusion: The renewed debt was subject to section 9(1), rather than being governed only by section 13, because the original indebtedness arose after the statutory cutoff for older debts and before the Act commenced.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 7 and 9(1), including the proviso to section 9(1), require the court to trace a renewed debt to the date of the prior debt and apply the scaling provisions applicable to that date. Section 8, Explanation III, similarly addresses renewals of older debts. The provisions must be read harmoniously, giving effect to each and construing the beneficial legislation to advance its purpose. The Court approved Nagabhushanam v. Seetharamaiah, I.L.R. [1961] 1 A.P. 485, and rejected the contrary view in Thiruvengadatha Ayyangar v. Sannappan Servai, I.L.R. [1942] Mad. 57.

rule.if: agriculturist_debt_recovery_proceeding and renewal_after_commencement and original_debt_before_commencement and original_debt_after_older_debt_cutoff

predicates.agriculturist_debt_recovery_proceeding: A court is considering recovery or scaling of a debt owed by an agriculturist.
predicates.renewal_after_commencement: The debtor executed a document renewing the debt after the relevant relief legislation commenced.
predicates.original_debt_before_commencement: The underlying indebtedness arose before the relevant relief legislation commenced.
predicates.original_debt_after_older_debt_cutoff: The underlying indebtedness arose after the cutoff separating older debts from debts subject to the intermediate-period scaling rule.

issues.definition: When an agriculturist's debt recovery proceeding concerns a debt renewed after commencement, and the original debt arose before commencement but after the older-debt cutoff, the renewed debt receives the intermediate-debt scaling treatment.

issues.legal_issue: The rule governing future interest on a debt depends on whether the transaction giving rise to the debt occurred before or after commencement of the relief legislation.
material_facts: The debtors executed the promissory note after the relief legislation commenced and agreed to pay interest on the amount recorded in it.
The note renewed indebtedness arising from earlier dealings.
The dispute concerned the amount recoverable on the renewed debt.
issues.conclusion: Future interest on a transaction entered into after commencement is governed by section 13; transactions entered into before commencement and covered by sections 8 and 9 are governed by section 12.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 12 and 13 provide for future interest on different classes of transactions: section 12 applies to transactions before commencement that are covered by sections 8 and 9, while section 13 applies to transactions after commencement. Section 13 provides a maximum rate of interest for the post-commencement category; it does not create a separate category that prevents sections 8 and 9 from applying to a renewal of an earlier debt.

predicates.agriculturist_debt_recovery_proceeding: A court is considering recovery or scaling of a debt owed by an agriculturist.
predicates.future_interest_claimed: A party seeks interest accruing after the relevant relief legislation commenced.
predicates.operative_transaction_after_commencement: The transaction on which the future-interest claim rests occurred after the relevant relief legislation commenced.

issues.definition: When future interest is claimed in an agriculturist debt recovery proceeding and the operative transaction occurred after commencement, the future interest is governed by the post-commencement interest rule.
